extraction.notes: Q2 2026 (three months ended June 30, 2026) column used. EQR reports no AFFO; the reconciliation ends at Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units, so affo fields are null. The FFO section starts at Net income and runs through NCI and preferred distributions to FFO available to Common Shares and Units (382,461); these two pre-FFO lines are included as adjustments. Pass-through check: 117,740 -> 382,461 -> 393,369 reproduces. Diluted shares 383,878 gives FFO/share 1.00 and Normalized FFO/share 1.02, matching reported. 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' (-11,376) is categorized as 'other' because the filing does not specify whether it is real estate land or non-real-estate investments. Recurring capex is only disclosed on a six-month basis (94,566, total consolidated), not for the quarter; recorded as year_to_date with that basis flagged. Per-share FFO matched to the printed diluted FFO per share figure in the earnings release appendix, which shows $1.00 for Q2 2026.
